university: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
official_facts: The programme emphasises quantitative methods and techniques to understand the modern economy and public policy.
Its curriculum connects economics with finance, analytical skills and quantitative research.
Students interested in research may take final-year honours thesis courses.

major_signals.look_for: Questions about incentives, markets, institutions, economic mechanisms or public policy, supported by reasoning.
Appropriate use of data, statistical assumptions, measurement, counterexamples and uncertainty.
A reasoned connection between financial decisions and economic theory or empirical methods, beyond trading success.

overclaim_warnings: Trading returns alone do not establish economics interest.
Do not reward statistical jargon without evidence the applicant understands its limits.

sources.title: HKUST Undergraduate Admissions: Economics and Finance

interpretation_note: major_signals are evaluation heuristics inferred from programme content, not a published admissions marking scheme. Confirm exact 2027 requirements at submission.
